title: psyllium indicum subsp. orientale
intro: Psyllium indicum subsp. orientale, commonly known as Indian plantago, is a plant species that belongs to the family Plantaginaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include promoting digestive health, lowering cholesterol levels, and aiding in weight management due to its high fiber content. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which help in soothing digestive issues and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Psyllium indicum subsp. orientale include mucilages, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
